summary: Frontend-only regression + NEW flick/aim & drag-to-zoom validation for Pen Fight. All new behaviors verified against live preview URL via Playwright: drag-to-zoom scales canvas <1 mid-drag (measured scale=0.786 for a 140px drag) and reverts to scale(1) on mouseup; pen selection continues to register on wrapper-level listeners despite canvas transform; off-center flick executes without console errors; turn indicator transitions to 'moving' (…) then to opponent; Quit returns to main menu; local 2-player mode alternates BLUE -> RED after a flick. Zero console/page errors captured during full test sequence.
critical_code_review_comments: PenFight.js is ~410 lines with useEffect setup, physics helpers, AI logic, input handlers and render loop all inline. Consider extracting input/aiming, AI move, and eliminations/turn state machine into hooks/modules for maintainability.

In onMove, transform is applied to canvas each pointer move without rAF batching; combined with CSS transition:0.14s ease-out this is fine visually, but consider rAF-throttling to avoid layout thrash on slower devices.

onUp uses grab point (st.aiming.start) as the impulse point, but if the drag is capped at CFG.maxDrag, ratio uses capped magnitude while the direction uses rawMag; this is correct but subtle — an inline comment would help.
Turn indicator text uses ellipsis '…' during 'moving' state; screen readers/tests can't distinguish states. Consider aria-label or an explicit data attribute (e.g., data-turn-state='moving').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canvas logical 900x600. Pointer listeners are on wrapperRef, canvas is transformed. To flick: page.mouse.down at pen screen pos (player pens at logical y=468, x in {222,374,526,678}), then move in ~7 stepped increments totaling >=100px, then mouse.up. Mid-drag CSS transform on [data-testid=game-canvas] should be scale(<1) (approx 0.79 for ~140px drag; min zoomMin=0.42). After mouseup transform snaps back to scale(1) via 0.14s CSS transition (read >200ms later). Turn indicator shows Blue/Red or '…' during moving; allow ~7s for pens to rest before turn switches. Mute toggle is only inside gameplay HUD (data-testid=mute-toggle appears in Hud), not on main menu.
